title: SurveyCollected@1
description: A Project Store event (ADR-0159 clause 13): the tombstone of a Survey the Storage Budget collected, appended before its record leaves the Store's CAS. A `SurveyRecorded@1` whose Survey a tombstone names replays as collected, bound to the tombstone: `head`, `cutoff_unix_s`, `completeness`, `refs_digest`, `policy_digest`, `surveyor_version` and `previous_survey_id` are copied from the record after the event was verified against it, never from the event, and replay refuses an event that differs from its tombstone on any of them. `af project history` answers for the Survey from the tombstone. `tree` and `history` keep the record's totals; each is absent when the record held no such section. A record whose bytes were read but are no Survey, or that is gone from the CAS, vouches for nothing: it is collected with `unreadable` in place of both totals, and its tombstone keeps the event's fields as collection read them; a record that could not be read is never collected.

survey_id.description: The CAS digest the collected record had.

previous_survey_id.description: The record's `previous_survey_id`, when it names one.

unreadable.description: Why the record's bytes are no Survey (they do not match its digest, or do not parse): af's own sentence, never the record's content, a path or an email.
